verdict.rationale: The API offers agentic building blocks you can delegate tasks to. Agents can plan and complete tasks with tools and keep context across steps, and a managed Codex harness handles session orchestration. Built-in tools include web search, file search, computer use, hosted shell and apply patch. However, the developer must assemble the assistant from these pieces; nothing shows a turnkey assistant built into the product itself, such as the dashboard. Missing for 10: a ready-made in-product assistant users can delegate to without building one, and independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation through the API.
